templates.title: Gemini CLI

companions.title: Gemini CLI · .env
companions.instructions: Gemini CLI reads its base URL (and, in gateway mode, its key) from environment variables only. It auto-loads ~/.gemini/.env, so put them there rather than exporting them per shell.

templates.title: Gemini CLI · MCP only (static key)
templates.instructions: Merge into ~/.gemini/settings.json alongside any existing `security.auth` / `mcpServers` blocks. No LLM key is minted in this flow — Gemini CLI keeps whatever GEMINI_API_KEY / GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL is already configured. Usage statistics to Google and the update check are off (`privacy.usageStatisticsEnabled`, `general.enableAutoUpdate`, `general.enableAutoUpdateNotification`); an admin who wants them back can edit this template.
